title: Run the FR-40 experiment and record its verdict
body:
FR-40 slice 4 of 4 (parent t-y46gy0w). Run the experiment and record the verdict.
What: run the frozen manifest with `krn eval session` (Codex gpt-6-luna, mask on, AGENTS.md on in every arm) in the planned shuffled order; stop after 20 tasks if B is not ahead; record every run's session.json and score; arms that cannot run are reported invalid with reasons.
Acceptance: results table and GO/KILL/inconclusive verdicts against D20 thresholds committed under evals/fr40/; t-y46gy0w closed with the verdict; ADR 0002 status updated only if GO.

From t-j5xq3zn: krn eval score/report and the frozen evals/fr40/manifest.json exist. The runner composes each run's prompt (task prompt from evals/fr40/tasks.json plus arm material from material.json: none, packet, standards) for krn eval session --prompt-file, runs the first session end to end against scripts/codex/mock-responses.ts, then scores and reports it. That mock-provider run is the open part of t-j5xq3zn's acceptance; the report is proven on real scorer verdicts in test/evals/fr40-report.test.ts.

Result: GO (packets and retrieval), evals/fr40/results.md; 399/399 sessions under config 1611c2e5, 0 scorer errors; B-A +21.1 pp (36/8, p<0.0001), B-S +11.3 pp (26/11, p=0.010), token ratio 1.086. Follow-up t-b9zs937.
